summary: GitBucket is a self-hosted Git repository hosting / GitHub-compatible server (Scala + Slick + Scalatra): accounts/users/groups, repositories (create/rename/transfer/delete/fork), issues & comments, pull requests & merge, labels/milestones/priorities/custom fields, releases & assets, protected branches, collaborators, webhooks, wiki (git-backed pages), commit-status, personal access tokens, system settings (gitbucket.conf file); all state persisted to an SQL DB via Slick services with Scallatra HTTP routes, and read back through the same services.
